sentences.en: A few days ago, for the first time, an American jury convicted a parent for a mass shooting carried out by their child.
sentences.zh: 几天前，美国陪审团历史上首次判定一名家长对其孩子实施的大规模枪击事件有罪。

sentences.en: My colleague, Lisa Miller, has been reporting on the case from the beginning and explains what the historic verdict really means.
sentences.zh: 我的同事莉萨·米勒从一开始就在报道这起案件，她将为我们解释这一历史性判决的真正含义。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, February 8th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月8日，星期四。

sentences.en: Lisa, you came to this story as a writer for New York Magazine two years ago.
sentences.zh: 莉萨，你两年前是以《纽约杂志》作家的身份接触到这个故事的。

sentences.en: You just joined the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 你刚刚加入了《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: A couple of days ago, basically.
sentences.zh: 基本上就在几天前。

sentences.en: And you came to this story right after this horrible shooting and long before any kind of trial was underway.
sentences.zh: 你是在这起可怕的枪击事件发生后不久、且在任何审判开始很久之前就关注到这个故事的。

sentences.en: What was it that drew you to this particular case?
sentences.zh: 是什么吸引你关注这个特定案件的？

sentences.en: There are so many mass shootings in the United States.
sentences.zh: 美国发生了那么多起大规模枪击事件。

sentences.en: Well, first and foremost, I have covered school shootings, and so I'm familiar with all of the pain and agony around these events.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先也是最重要的是，我报道过校园枪击案，所以我对这些事件周围的所有痛苦和悲痛都非常熟悉。

sentences.en: I covered Sandy Hook.
sentences.zh: 我报道过桑迪胡克小学枪击案。

sentences.en: I covered Parkland.
sentences.zh: 我报道过帕克兰枪击案。

sentences.en: So I've been immersed in these cultures for a long time.
sentences.zh: 所以我长期沉浸在这种文化中。

sentences.en: The circumstances of this particular shooting were highly unusual.
sentences.zh: 这起特定枪击案的情况非常不寻常。

sentences.en: These parents, James and Jennifer Crumbly, bought their son, Ethan, who was 15 years old, a gun on Black Friday, the day after Thanksgiving, as an early Christmas present.
sentences.zh: 这对父母，詹姆斯和珍妮弗·克拉姆利，在“黑色星期五”（感恩节的次日）给他们15岁的儿子伊森买了一把枪，作为提前的圣诞礼物。

sentences.en: The morning of the shooting, they were called to the school because the child had been drawing these very alarming pictures.
sentences.zh: 枪击事件当天早上，他们被叫到学校，因为这孩子画了非常令人担忧的画。

sentences.en: They left the kid at school.
sentences.zh: 他们把孩子留在了学校。

sentences.en: The kid then shot up the school, killing four of his classmates and injuring seven other people.
sentences.zh: 随后，这个孩子在学校开枪行凶，杀害了四名同学，并打伤了其他七人。

sentences.en: He was captured and charged with 24 counts, including terrorism, and charged as an adult.
sentences.zh: 他被捕并面临24项指控，包括恐怖主义罪，并且作为成年人接受审判。

sentences.en: The parents were charged several days after the shooting with involuntary manslaughter.
sentences.zh: 枪击发生几天后，父母被指控犯有过失杀人罪。

sentences.en: The first time basically in the era of mass shooting school shootings that parents were held responsible.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是美国大规模校园枪击案时代中，父母首次被追究责任。

sentences.en: criminally responsible for what their kid had done in school shootings the parents are always sued
sentences.zh: 在校园枪击案中被追究刑事责任，父母总是会被家属起诉

sentences.en: by the families it's normal but to make their actions and inactions a crime was extraordinary
sentences.zh: 这很正常，但将他们的行为和不作为定为犯罪是非同寻常的

sentences.en: and for me this raised all of these questions about you know how responsible is a parent
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这引发了所有这些问题，比如你知道家长对孩子的犯罪行为要承担多大责任

sentences.en: for a child's criminal acts and what is a parent expected to know or not know about what their teenager is doing, thinking, planning.
sentences.zh: 以及对于青少年的所作所为、所思所想，社会期望家长知道或不知道什么。

sentences.en: What raises alarms?
sentences.zh: 什么会拉响警报？

sentences.en: What doesn't raise alarm?
sentences.zh: 什么不会拉响警报？

sentences.en: I mean, all of these questions are very compelling and murky.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，所有这些问题都非常引人深思又模糊不清。

sentences.en: They kind of get to the heart of what it means to be a parent.
sentences.zh: 它们触及了为人父母的核心意义。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so as I'm thinking about all these big questions, I'm also talking to legal experts in Michigan about the prosecutor's case and whether this was a possible case to bring
sentences.zh: 因此，当我在思考所有这些宏大问题时，我也在与密歇根州的法律专家交流，讨论检察官的案件以及这是否是一起可以对这对父母提起诉讼的案件

sentences.en: against these parents, James and Jennifer Crumbly, because what they were saying to me, what the legal experts were saying, was that there's this bedrock principle in U.S.
sentences.zh: 也就是詹姆斯和珍妮弗·克拉姆利，因为他们对我说的话，法律专家们所说的是，美国法律中存在这样一个基石原则

sentences.en: law, which is I'm responsible for what I do and you're responsible for what you do.
sentences.zh: 即我对自己的行为负责，你对你的行为负责。

sentences.en: So how do you put the Crumbly parents in between Ethan, who pulled the trigger and killed four of his classmates, and make them criminally responsible for those children's deaths,
sentences.zh: 那么，你如何将克拉姆利夫妇置于扣动扳机并杀害四名同学的伊森之间，让他们对那些儿童的死承担刑事责任呢

sentences.en: especially when he'd been charged as an adult.
sentences.zh: 特别是当他已经被作为成年人起诉的情况下。

sentences.en: So you're saying from the very start
sentences.zh: 所以你是说从一开始

sentences.en: you're getting the sense from this reporting that this is going to be an uphill prosecution.
sentences.zh: 你从这次报道中感觉到，这是一场艰难的起诉。

sentences.en: It's an innovative prosecution.
sentences.zh: 这是一次创新的起诉。

sentences.en: It's a bold prosecution.
sentences.zh: 这是一次大胆的起诉。

sentences.en: It's potentially a game-changing prosecution in this era of mass shootings.
sentences.zh: 在这个大规模枪击案频发的时代，这可能是一次具有颠覆意义的起诉。

sentences.en: But just practically speaking it's going to be hard to get a guilty verdict.
sentences.zh: 但仅从实际角度来看，要获得有罪判决将是困难的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And then I went to the town where this happened
sentences.zh: 然后我去了事发的小镇

sentences.en: Oxford, Michigan.
sentences.zh: 密歇根州的牛津镇。

sentences.en: And when I got there, my overwhelming impression was twofold, that the town reviles these parents.
sentences.zh: 当我到达那里时，我的压倒性印象有两个：一是这个小镇痛恨这对父母。

sentences.en: They are seen as outsiders, irresponsible, and it's a tiny town, 22,000 people, with four kids dead.
sentences.zh: 他们被视为外人、不负责任，而且这是一个只有2万人的小镇，却有四个孩子丧生。

sentences.en: Everybody knows a family who suffered a terrible loss, and that is palpable.
sentences.zh: 每个人都认识一个遭受了巨大痛苦的家庭，这种悲痛是显而易见的。

sentences.en: It is palpable in the courtroom in the hearing I went to, and it is palpable in every interview with a parent I had.
sentences.zh: 在我去参加听证会的法庭上能感受到这种悲痛，在我对任何一位父母的采访中也能感受到。

sentences.en: That was the first thing.
sentences.zh: 这是第一点。

sentences.en: The second thing is that everybody in town owns a gun.
sentences.zh: 第二点是镇上的每个人都有一把枪。

sentences.en: Everybody was raised with guns, and they talk a lot about responsible gun ownership.
sentences.zh: 每个人都是伴随着枪支长大的，他们经常谈论负责任的枪支所有权。

sentences.en: And so the fact that this kid had access to this gun is negligence on the part of the parents.
sentences.zh: 因此，这个孩子能够接触到这把枪，这本身就是父母的疏忽。

sentences.en: and I use the word negligence in the casual, non-legal way.
sentences.zh: 我这里用的是日常生活中非法律意义上的“疏忽”一词。

sentences.en: And so as I start watching the trial of Jennifer Crumbly, which started a couple of weeks ago,
sentences.zh: 因此，当我开始观看几周前开始的珍妮弗·克拉姆利的审判时

sentences.en: I know these two things, and they are in opposition to each other.
sentences.zh: 我了解到了这两点，而它们是相互对立的。

sentences.en: One is that the community is absolutely furious at these parents, and especially at the mother.
sentences.zh: 一是社区对这对父母绝对愤怒，尤其是对这位母亲。

sentences.en: And the other is, the legal experts have told me that this is going to be a really hard case to win.
sentences.zh: 二是法律专家告诉我，这将是一起非常难赢的官司。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So take us into the actual trial of Jennifer Crumbly.
sentences.zh: 那么，带我们进入珍妮弗·克拉姆利真正的审判现场。

sentences.en: Your Honor, calling people versus Jennifer Crumbly, case number 22279-990-FH.
sentences.zh: 法官大人，现在开庭审理人民诉珍妮弗·克拉姆利案，案号22279-990-FH。

sentences.en: What's always been so compelling to me about Jennifer Crumbly as a character is that you can see her in two entirely different lights.
sentences.zh: 作为一个人，珍妮弗·克拉姆利最吸引我的地方在于，你可以从两个完全不同的角度来看待她。

sentences.en: And the prosecution and the defense are going to describe her completely differently.
sentences.zh: 控方和辩方对她的描述将完全不同。

sentences.en: Jennifer Crumbly didn't pull the trigger that day, But she is responsible for those deaths.
sentences.zh: 那天扣动扳机的不是珍妮弗·克拉姆利，但她对这些死亡负有责任。

sentences.en: So the prosecution is painting a picture of a reckless, negligent parent who is concerned about everything but the care of her very disturbed son
sentences.zh: 因此，检方描绘了一个鲁莽、疏忽的母亲形象，她关心一切，唯独不关心她那个精神极度错乱的儿子

sentences.en: and that she had every reason to know that her son was very distressed.
sentences.zh: 并且她有充分的理由知道自己的儿子处于极度痛苦之中。

sentences.en: And so what the prosecution has to do is prove what in the law is called foreseeability.
sentences.zh: 因此，检方必须证明法律上所称的“可预见性”。

sentences.en: The school shooter was in a downward spiral that had begun months before.
sentences.zh: 这名校园枪手正处于几个月前就开始的急剧恶化之中。

sentences.en: Jennifer Crumbly was aware of that.
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗·克拉姆利对此是知情的。

sentences.en: That Jennifer Crumbly both could have known what her son was able to do and could have foreseen the harm he was going to commit to others.
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗·克拉姆利不仅本可以知道她的儿子能够做出什么事，而且本可以预见到他将对他人造成的伤害。

sentences.en: One thing will present itself during this round is just how senseless November 30th was.
sentences.zh: 这轮审判期间将呈现的一件事是，11月30日是多么毫无意义。

sentences.en: And that's because of all of the easy, ordinary things for someone to do that nobody did.
sentences.zh: 这是因为所有人都可以轻而易举做到的那些普通事情，却没有一个人去做。

sentences.en: The other legal term that's important here is a term called ordinary care.
sentences.zh: 这里另一个重要的法律术语叫做“普通注意义务”。

sentences.en: And what ordinary care means in this case is that an ordinary person in the same circumstances would have taken steps to intervene.
sentences.zh: 在本案中，“普通注意义务”意味着处于相同情况下的普通人会采取步骤进行干预。

sentences.en: Okay, and how do they attempt to show that in testimony?
sentences.zh: 好的，他们如何在证词中试图证明这一点？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: One of the first things they do is they show that she knew that her husband had bought their son a gun.
sentences.zh: 他们做的第一件事就是证明她知道她丈夫给他们的儿子买了一把枪。

sentences.en: They show that the gun was sold with a cable lock and both her husband and Ethan were given a pamphlet about gun safety along with the gun.
sentences.zh: 他们表明，这把枪在出售时附带了一条密码锁，而且她丈夫和伊森在买枪时都收到了一份关于枪支安全的宣传册。

sentences.en: And then an ATF agent took the stand and testified that when police officers got to the house after the shooting, they found that the gun safe was set to 0-0-0.
sentences.zh: 随后，一名烟酒枪炮及爆裂物管理局（ATF）特工出庭作证称，枪击发生后，当警察赶到屋里时，他们发现保险箱的密码被设为了0-0-0。

sentences.en: What's significant about 0-0-0?
sentences.zh: 0-0-0有什么意义？

sentences.en: That is generally the factory default for a lot of safes.
sentences.zh: 这通常是许多保险箱的出厂默认设置。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: That the cable lock that had been sold with the gun looks almost new.
sentences.zh: 随枪出售的那条密码锁看起来几乎全新。

sentences.en: Had never been used.
sentences.zh: 从未被使用过。

sentences.en: Jennifer herself took Ethan to the shooting range.
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗本人带伊森去了靶场。

sentences.en: Who's the surveillance of?
sentences.zh: 监控录像里是谁？

sentences.en: It shows Jennifer Crumley and the shooter entering the gun range.
sentences.zh: 画面显示珍妮弗·克伦利和枪手进入了靶场。

sentences.en: On the Saturday after they bought him the gun.
sentences.zh: 就在他们给他买枪后的那个星期六。

sentences.en: And then they proceed to take turns firing the Sig Sauer pistol.
sentences.zh: 然后他们轮流开枪射击那把西格绍尔手枪。

sentences.en: That Ethan was very experienced with the gun.
sentences.zh: 伊森对这把枪非常熟练。

sentences.en: This was a semi-automatic 9mm Sig Sauer, and he fired many rounds in what's called a shooter's stance.
sentences.zh: 这是一把半自动9毫米西格绍尔手枪，他以所谓的“射手姿态”打出了很多发子弹。

sentences.en: In other words, Jennifer Crumley would have understood that her son, because she was there, was becoming quite proficient in shooting a gun.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，由于珍妮弗·克伦利就在现场，她本应明白她的儿子在熟练掌握射击技术。

sentences.en: Yes, and that there seemed to be a culture of laissez-faire gun safety in the house.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且家里似乎存在一种自由放任的枪支安全文化。

sentences.en: And then the next person the prosecution brings on the stand is a sheriff's deputy who has been through all the family's texts, messages,
sentences.zh: 接下来，检方传唤了一名警长副手，他检查了枪击发生前一年里这个家庭所有的短信、消息

sentences.en: cell phone calls over the past year before the shooting and finds basically a documentary of family life, you know, conversations about what's for dinner, who's doing what,
sentences.zh: 以及手机通话记录，基本上找到了家庭生活的纪录片，你知道的，关于晚饭吃什么、谁在做什么的对话

sentences.en: who's picking up who.
sentences.zh: 谁去接谁。

sentences.en: But in the middle of all of those family conversations...
sentences.zh: 但在所有这些家庭对话的中间...

sentences.en: There are some texts that show that Ethan is very distressed.
sentences.zh: 有一些短信显示伊森非常痛苦。

sentences.en: He says, OK, the house is now haunted.
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧，这房子现在闹鬼了。

sentences.en: And then what?
sentences.zh: 然后呢？

sentences.en: Some weird shit just happens and now I'm scared.
sentences.zh: 发生了一些奇怪的破事，现在我很害怕。

sentences.zh: 家里有个恶魔。

sentences.zh: 它在扔碗。

sentences.zh: “碗”这个词全部是大写字母。

sentences.en: He's freaked out.
sentences.zh: 他吓坏了。

sentences.zh: 然后在他描述完这个所谓的幻觉结束时，他写道

sentences.zh: 你至少能回个短信吗？

sentences.zh: 你至少能给我回个短信吗？

sentences.zh: 结果怎么样？

sentences.zh: 被发送信息的被告给出的下一个回应是什么时候？

sentences.zh: 两天后。

sentences.zh: 检方出示证据表明她没有回复。

sentences.zh: 事实上，她当时正在骑马，还给自己骑马拍了照片。

sentences.en: And the prosecution wants to show that her care for her horses exceeds her care for her son.
sentences.zh: 检方希望借此证明，她对马匹的关心超过了对儿子的关心。

sentences.en: In addition, Ethan had one very, very close friend, his best friend.
sentences.zh: 此外，伊森有一个非常非常亲密的朋友，也就是他最好的朋友。

sentences.en: And the communication between Ethan and his friend was constant at all hours of the day and night.
sentences.zh: 伊森和他的朋友之间的交流在一天中的任何时间都从未间断。

sentences.en: And in those communications, he told his friend that he was falling apart.
sentences.zh: 在这些交流中，他告诉朋友他快崩溃了。

sentences.zh: 枪手说：“我昨天其实要求我爸爸带我去看了医生，但他只是给了我一些药，并叫我，引述他的话说，‘挺过去’。”

sentences.en: He wasn't sleeping.
sentences.zh: 他睡不着觉。

sentences.zh: 他在淋浴间里又笑又哭。

sentences.en: He then says, like, I am mentally and physically dying.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，就像，我在精神上和肉体上都在死去。

sentences.zh: 他考虑过自己拨打911报警。

sentences.zh: 但指控珍妮弗·克拉布利犯有过失杀人罪并不能解决任何这些问题。

sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.zh: 在证词中，珍妮弗·克拉布利还表示，她从没想过她的儿子需要去看心理健康专家，他的

sentences.en: behavior made her think that he needed one.
sentences.zh: 任何行为都没有让她觉得他需要去看。

sentences.en: Even if the jury accepts that argument, there's still the question, of course, of why Jennifer
sentences.zh: 即使陪审团接受了这种说法，当然还有一个问题，那就是为什么珍妮弗

sentences.en: Cumbly did what she did or what she didn't do when she was called to the school on the day of the shooting.
sentences.zh: ·克拉布利在枪击案当天被叫到学校时，会做出她所做的事情，或者没有做她该做的事。

sentences.en: So how does she talk about that and how does the defense lawyer present it?
sentences.zh: 那么她是如何谈论这件事的，辩护律师又是如何陈述的呢？

sentences.en: So in her testimony, Jennifer says that she feels somewhat relieved after that meeting.
sentences.zh: 所以在证词中，珍妮弗说开完会后她感到有些如释重负。

sentences.en: I thought he was going to get in trouble for what he drew on his assignment.
sentences.zh: 我以为他会因为在作业上画的东西而惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: I was expecting, like, a disciplinary meeting.
sentences.zh: 我原以为会是一场纪律处分会议。

sentences.en: She rushed to the school, worried that her kid was in trouble.
sentences.zh: 她急忙赶到学校，担心自己的孩子惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: And she's relieved that Ethan isn't in trouble.
sentences.zh: 而她感到欣慰的是伊森并没有惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: Shannon, her lawyer, notes that everybody in the room is a mandatory reporter, which means that if they thought that Ethan was a danger to himself or to others,
sentences.zh: 她的律师香农指出，房间里的每个人都是强制报告人，这意味着如果他们认为伊森对自己或他人构成危险，

sentences.en: that they could call the police or call a state social worker and take him into custody.
sentences.zh: 他们本可以报警或致电州社会工作者并将其拘留。

sentences.en: And nobody does that.
sentences.zh: 但没有人这么做。

sentences.en: It was pretty nonchalant.
sentences.zh: 当时显得相当漫不经心。

sentences.en: It was pretty brief.
sentences.zh: 过程相当简短。

sentences.en: He said that my son told him that he was feeling sad over the death of a dog that we had.
sentences.zh: 他说我的儿子告诉他，他为我们曾经养过的一只狗的死感到难过。

sentences.en: So we talked a little bit about that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们稍微聊了聊这件事。

sentences.en: And so there's this sense, at least from Jennifer's point of view, that the urgency, the immediate urgency, has been diffused and that everybody can go on with their day.
sentences.zh: 因此，至少从珍妮弗的角度来看，有一种感觉，即那种紧迫感、眼前的紧迫感已经消散了，每个人都可以继续过他们的日子。

sentences.en: Did you feel like you were taking the position of, I am leaving him at school, whether he can be here or not?
sentences.zh: 你当时觉得自己是在坚持这样一种立场吗：我要把他留在学校，不管他能不能待在这里？

sentences.en: No, absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 不，绝对不是。

sentences.en: My son gets very stressed out when he does virtual school, so we agree that it might stress him out more to do his school remotely the rest of the day.
sentences.zh: 我儿子上网课时压力非常大，所以我们一致认为，如果今天剩下的时间让他远程上课，可能会给他带来更大的压力。

sentences.en: That the decision to leave Ethan at school was a decision for his safety, for his health, and that they would deal with what they needed to deal with.
sentences.zh: 把伊桑留在学校是为了他的安全和健康所做出的决定，他们会处理需要处理的事情。

sentences.en: Anon.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Does Jennifer's lawyer bring up the question of the gun?
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗的律师有没有提出关于枪支的问题？

sentences.en: The fact, as the prosecution has claimed, that Jennifer Crumley does not bridge the informational gap that the school officials would have had in that moment,
sentences.zh: 正如检方所声称的那样，珍妮弗·克拉姆利并没有弥合学校官员当时所缺失的信息鸿沟，

sentences.en: that perhaps that drawing Ethan makes on his geometry worksheet is a reference to a gun that Jennifer knows the family possesses.
sentences.zh: 也许伊桑在他的几何作业纸上画的那幅画，是在暗示珍妮弗知道家里有一把枪。

sentences.en: Jennifer says that she was not thinking about there being any danger from the gun.
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗说她当时根本没有想到这把枪会带来任何危险。

sentences.en: You know, and Shannon, her lawyer, continually says that the murders are facts in hindsight.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，她的律师香农一直在说，谋杀案是事后诸葛亮得出的事实。

sentences.en: Do you believe that you knew or had reason to know your son was a danger to anyone else?
sentences.zh: 你是否认为你知道或有理由知道你的儿子对其他人构成了危险？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: As a parent, you spend your whole life trying to protect your child from other dangers.
sentences.zh: 作为父母，你花了一生时间试图保护你的孩子免受其他危险的伤害。

sentences.en: You never would think you have to protect your child from harming somebody else.
sentences.zh: 你绝不会想到你还得保护你的孩子不去伤害别人。

sentences.en: That was the hardest thing I had to stomach, is that my child harmed and killed other people.
sentences.zh: 这是我最难以下咽的事实，那就是我的孩子伤害并杀害了其他人。

sentences.en: So in a sense, what the defense is doing here is saying there is no foreseeability when it comes to Jennifer Crumbly.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种意义上，辩方在这里所做的是在说，就珍妮弗·克拉姆利而言，这一切是无法预见的。

sentences.en: Yes, jury, in retrospect, this all looks perhaps kind of cut and dry.
sentences.zh: 是的，陪审团，事后看来，这一切也许都显得有点简单明了。

sentences.en: These texts, these conversations, the purchase of the gun, all of it.
sentences.zh: 这些短信、这些对话、购买枪支的过程，全都是如此。

sentences.en: And they're saying for her, in reality, in real time, it wasn't cut and dry at all.
sentences.zh: 而他们所说的是，对她而言，在现实中，在当时当刻，事情一点也不简单明了。

sentences.en: And she did not think her son was capable of this or that there was anything to stop.
sentences.zh: 她并不认为她的儿子有能力做出这种事，也不觉得有什么事情需要去阻止。

sentences.en: No, and in Shannon's closing remarks, she says this.
sentences.zh: 是的，在香农的结案陈词中，她确实这么说了。

sentences.en: She says, Jennifer, one of the first things she says when she goes to the police station after the shooting is, you know, he's a good kid.
sentences.zh: 她说，珍妮弗在枪击案发生后去警察局时说的第一批话之一就是，你知道的，他是个好孩子。

sentences.en: He's never gotten in trouble.
sentences.zh: 他从来没有惹过麻烦。

sentences.en: So as we now know, the jury rejects this version of Jennifer Crumbly, the one who is not negligent, the one who is a helicopter parent and who couldn't foresee what was happening,
sentences.zh: 正如我们现在所知，陪审团拒绝了珍妮弗·克拉姆利的这种说法——即她没有疏忽、她是一个全天候监视孩子的直升机家长、并且无法预见正在发生的事情这一说法，

sentences.en: and they find her guilty.
sentences.zh: 他们裁定她有罪。

sentences.en: What was your reaction when you heard that news?
sentences.zh: 当你听到这个消息时，你的反应是什么？

sentences.en: Well, as I said, I really struggled with, you know, the tension between this fragile case that the prosecutors were building, that everybody said was a fragile case,
sentences.zh: 嗯，正如我所说，我真的很纠结，你知道的，这种紧张关系存在于检察官们构建的这个脆弱案件——所有人都在说这是一个脆弱的案件——

sentences.en: and the overpowering desire of the community to see Jennifer Crumbly in prison.
sentences.zh: 与社区迫切希望看到珍妮弗·克拉姆利入狱的强烈愿望之间。

sentences.en: And the law is there both to provide guardrails on behavior, but also to reflect a community's will in some way.
sentences.zh: 法律的存在既是为了对行为设定护栏，也是为了在某种程度上反映社区的意愿。

sentences.en: Well, what does that mean for the future of this type of prosecution?
sentences.zh: 那么，这对这种类型的起诉的未来意味着什么？

sentences.en: This was a firSt.
sentences.zh: 这还是头一遭。

sentences.en: it may not be a last but it also I think is a question of whether it will become common after a school shooting after a mass shooting involving a young person
sentences.zh: 这或许不会是最后一次，但我也认为这关乎未来在发生校园枪击案、发生涉及年轻人的大规模枪击案后，

sentences.en: for a prosecutor to go after the parents I mean are the circumstances here so unique that this does feel like a new template or an anomaly if I had to pick one of those
sentences.zh: 检察官是否会开始起诉父母。我是说，这里的环境是如此独特，以至于这感觉像是一个新的模板还是一个特例？如果必须二选一的话，

sentences.en: I would lean toward anomaly for several reasons.
sentences.zh: 由于几个原因，我更倾向于认为这是一个特例。

sentences.en: One is that the circumstances of this case are so unusual and also that lots and lots and lots of kids die from gunshot wounds every year.
sentences.zh: 其一是这起案件的情况非常罕见，另一个原因是每年都有成千上万的孩子死于枪伤。

sentences.en: I think the number I have is more than 4,000 in 2021.
sentences.zh: 我想我掌握的数据是2021年超过了4000人。

sentences.en: More kids die from gunshot wounds than anything else in the country.
sentences.zh: 在美国，死于枪伤的孩子比死于其他任何东西的都要多。

sentences.en: Anything else in the country, including car crashes.
sentences.zh: 比国内其他任何死因都要多，包括车祸。

sentences.en: So is this how we're going to start addressing the problem of guns and gun violence in America by holding individual parents accountable?
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是我们要开始解决美国枪支和枪支暴力问题的方式吗？通过追究单个父母的责任？

sentences.en: I mean, maybe it will work as a deterrent, but it does seem to be trying to circumnavigate the more direct approach to control access to guns, to control guns,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这或许能起到威慑作用，但这似乎是在试图绕过更直接的方法，即控制枪支获取、管控枪支、

sentences.en: to control who's buying the guns.
sentences.zh: 控制到底是谁在买枪。

sentences.en: Well, what's the risk in circumnavigating what is clearly an intransigent gun control debate in this country that's not going anywhere?
sentences.zh: 那么，绕过美国国内显然毫无进展且陷入僵局的枪控辩论，风险在哪里？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: The risk is that you start making parents responsible, criminally responsible, not just ethically or morally responsible,
sentences.zh: 风险在于，你开始让父母承担责任，承担刑事责任，而不仅仅是伦理或道德责任，

sentences.en: for things that it's very difficult to make parents responsible for, especially if the kids are teenagers and able to deceive, lie, manipulate, have secret lives.
sentences.zh: 去承担那些让父母负责极其困难的事情，特别是如果孩子们是青少年，并且擅长欺骗、撒谎、操纵、拥有秘密生活的话。

sentences.en: We all know what teenagers are like, right?
sentences.zh: 我们都知道青少年是什么样的，对吧？

sentences.en: And some of the legal experts I spoke to brought up comparable situations, such as you lend your kid a car, the kid gets drunk and kills somebody.
sentences.zh: 我采访过的一些法律专家提出了具有可比性的情况，比如你把车借给孩子，孩子酒驾并撞死了一个人。

sentences.en: Are you criminally responsible for that?
sentences.zh: 为此你要承担刑事责任吗？

sentences.en: It just seems like a slippery slope, and the legal experts are concerned about this.
sentences.zh: 这看起来像是一条滑坡谬误，法律专家们对此感到担忧。

sentences.en: Is what you're saying that a verdict like this, it might be emotionally satisfying,
sentences.zh: 你的意思是说，像这样的裁决，在情感上可能会让人感到满足，

sentences.en: But as satisfying as a verdict like this might be for some, legally, kind of spiritually, it's potentially quite problematic.
sentences.zh: 但无论这种裁决对某些人来说在法律上和某种精神层面上有多么满足，它都可能带来相当大的问题。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think parenting teenagers is really difficult.
sentences.zh: 我认为养育青少年真的很难。

sentences.en: Everybody will agree.
sentences.zh: 所有人都会同意这一点。

sentences.en: And there's a big distance between being an awful mom and being a criminally responsible one.
sentences.zh: 做一个糟糕的母亲与做一个应负刑事责任的母亲之间，有着很大的距离。

sentences.en: And one of the questions I have is, you know, if you start using the Crumbly case as a precedent for other parents, you know,
sentences.zh: 我心中的疑问之一是，你知道的，如果你开始把克拉姆利案作为其他父母的先例，你知道的，

sentences.en: how many parents who are good parents will get caught in this net?
sentences.zh: 会有多少好父母被这张网网进去？

sentences.en: I spoke to Sue Klebold for the story in New York Magazine.
sentences.zh: 我在《纽约杂志》的报道中采访了苏·克莱博尔德。

sentences.en: She was the mother of Dylan Klebold, who was one of the Columbine shooters.
sentences.zh: 她是科伦拜恩枪击案凶手之一迪伦·克莱博尔德的母亲。

sentences.en: And she was sort of the opposite of Jennifer Crumbly.
sentences.zh: 她某种程度上与珍妮弗·克拉姆利截然相反。

sentences.en: She was up in the middle of the night when her son came home from prom, and she was an invested member of the community, and she didn't allow guns in the house.
sentences.zh: 当她儿子从毕业舞会回家时，她还在半夜醒着，她是一个积极参与社区活动的成员，而且她不允许家里有枪。

sentences.en: And she told me not only did it still happen, but she had no idea.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，不仅悲剧还是发生了，而且她对此一无所知。

sentences.en: None.
sentences.zh: 完全不知情。

sentences.en: The shooting came as a total shock and surprise to her.
sentences.zh: 这场枪击案对她来说完全是一个巨大的打击和惊吓。

sentences.en: And those boys had been planning it for months.
sentences.zh: 而且那两个男孩已经策划了好几个月。

sentences.en: And six months after Columbine, she was taken to the police station where she was shown tapes that her son and the other shooter had made.
sentences.zh: 科伦拜恩枪击案发生六个月后，她被带到警察局，在那里观看了她儿子和另一个枪手制作的录像带。

sentences.en: And she said she didn't recognize him.
sentences.zh: 她说她都认不出自己的儿子了。

sentences.en: And there's all of this evidence that parents are actually some of the least insightful observers of their children.
sentences.zh: 有所有的证据表明，父母实际上往往是对自己孩子最缺乏洞察力的观察者之一。

sentences.en: 50% of kids who make suicide attempts, it's found that their parents don't know, have no idea.
sentences.zh: 人们发现，在尝试自杀的孩子中，有50%的父母根本不知道，完全不知情。

sentences.en: There was an FBI white paper on sort of the profile of the mass shooter,
sentences.zh: 有一份关于大规模枪击犯特征的联邦调查局白皮书，

sentences.en: and it said that parents are some of the least reliable reporters of the propensity to do violence like that.
sentences.zh: 上面说父母是对这种暴力倾向最不可靠的报告者之一。

sentences.en: And I guess one of the things that the Crumbly case makes me wonder is, if this is the model for the future,
sentences.zh: 我想克拉姆利案让我产生的一个疑问是，如果这就是未来的模版，

sentences.en: is it asking parents to be more clear-eyed about their children than is actually possible?
sentences.zh: 这是否是在要求父母对孩子的看法比实际可能做到的更加清醒？

sentences.en: Well, Lisa, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，丽莎，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感激。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.zh: 伊桑·克拉姆利父亲詹姆斯的过失杀人案审判计划于下个月初开始。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 他们要么选择符合国家利益的事情，要么选择在他们看来对唐纳德·特朗普有利的事情。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, Senate Republicans rejected a bill that did exactly what many of them had said they wanted, link billions of dollars in aid to Ukraine and Israel,
sentences.zh: 周三，参议院共和党人否决了一项法案，该法案完全符合他们许多人此前声称想要的诉求，即把对乌克兰和以色列的数十亿美元援助，

sentences.en: with stricter security measures at the U.S.-Mexico border.
sentences.zh: 与收紧美国南部边境的安全措施挂钩。

sentences.en: The vote came after former President Trump asked Republicans to kill the legislation.
sentences.zh: 在此次投票之前，前总统特朗普曾要求共和党人否决这项立法。

sentences.en: The vote marks the official demise of a rare bipartisan effort backed by President Biden and Senate leaders from both parties that for months appeared to be headed for passage.
sentences.zh: 这次投票标志着一项罕见的、得到拜登总统和两党参议院领袖支持的跨党派努力的正式夭折，而这项努力几个月来似乎一直有望获得通过。

sentences.zh: 而

sentences.zh: 以色列粉碎了与哈马斯达成长期停火协议可能近在咫尺的希望。

sentences.zh: 周三，以色列拒绝了哈马斯提出的释放以色列人质并结束加沙战斗的提议条款。

sentences.zh: 在一次新闻发布会上，以色列领导人本杰明·内塔尼亚胡称哈马斯的提议“异想天开”，并表示以色列将继续战斗，直到取得对哈马斯的彻底胜利。
